relationships.evidence_quote: after oHFS induction, the mean firing rate of pyramidal neurons in both the SNI group and sham group increased significantly

relationships.subject: MD-ACC projecting fibers
relationships.evidence_quote: suggesting that activation of MD-ACC projecting fibers induces mechanical allodynia in sham mice and hyperalgesia in SNI mice

key_findings: In vivo multichannel recording showed increased firing rate and FOS expression in ACC pyramidal cells but not interneurons in SNI mice, shifting the E/I balance toward excitation.
Optical HFS of MD-ACC afferents potentiated ACC pyramidal cell (not interneuron) firing and induced mechanical hypersensitivity in sham and SNI mice.
